This memorandum provides a status update on the Pinnacle Industries acquisition of DataStream Corp (MAT-078). The transaction remains on track for closing by Q3 2026. Due diligence is complete, and key contractual risks in the merger agreement have been identified and are under negotiation. Specifically, we have flagged a high-risk indemnification clause (Section 8.1) that currently requires Pinnacle to indemnify DataStream for claims arising from DataStream's own negligence. We recommend revising this to a mutual indemnification standard. Additionally, the non-compete clause (Section 12.1) is overly broad in both duration (24 months) and geographic scope; we are advising narrowing it to 12 months and limited to Delaware and contiguous states to enhance enforceability. A liability cap is in place, though it excludes consequential damages, which may impact recovery for lost profits. We are also recommending inclusion of a most-favored-nation pricing clause in post-merger service agreements.

Separately, regarding your oversight of MAT-042 (unrelated litigation), although not directly tied to this transaction, we note the following for your awareness: a settlement offer has been extended by opposing counsel, which proposes a reduced damages amount and includes a confidentiality provision. Our assessment indicates the judge is likely to deny summary judgment based on current motions, which strengthens our negotiating position. Opposing counsel has signaled openness to further discussions on damages, suggesting a favorable path toward resolution. We will continue to monitor both matters closely.
